metadata.title: U.S. City Open Data Catalog
metadata.scope: 50 largest U.S. city-proper entries by 2025 population estimates, plus 10 selected regional hubs. Curated starting datasets, not complete portal inventories.
metadata.verification: Publisher listings and indexed metadata reviewed. Dataset payloads were not downloaded or parsed. Research date is not dataset last-update date.

A.meaning: Published file URL or resolved layer API; not payload-tested.

B.meaning: Standard export/API endpoint constructed from an identified dataset ID; not payload-tested.

C.meaning: Dataset page with resource/export/API selection; exact data endpoint not resolved. Any CKAN API URL is catalog metadata, not the dataset rows.

metadata.coverage_notes: City, consolidated county and transit-service geographies differ. See each row.
metadata.license_notes: Public availability does not imply unrestricted reuse; review each publisher's terms.

cities.notes: City GIS hub selected because the legacy CKAN portal returned access errors during research.
JTA transit data covers its service area, not only the city boundary. Archive includes multiple feed versions.
Current publisher dataset pages use ArcGIS Hub. Coverage commonly includes Davidson County.
City jurisdiction is distinct from unincorporated Clark County and much of the Strip.
Mountain Metro transit service area. Official download URL located through the Transitland registry.
Regional portal; catalog entries explicitly identify City of Pittsburgh data.
City and County of Honolulu data can cover all Oahu; not only the Urban Honolulu CDP.
City jurisdiction; not all Orange County.
St. Louis city is separate from St. Louis County.
